title: Spending budgets for LLM calls
one_line: Hard and soft spend limits per app, model or tenant, checked before each call.
verified_against: Enforced through the openai 3.57.0, anthropic 2.12.0, google-genai 3.6.1 and botocore 1.44.9 clients over fake transports (no real provider call, no real bill). Shared counters exercised against real Redis 7.0.15, PostgreSQL 16.15 and MySQL 8.0.46 servers on localhost (threads and two processes) and SQLite. Prices are the packaged, unverified table.
snippet:
import briefcase
from briefcase import budgets

briefcase.auto()                       # instrument the provider SDKs
budgets.enable()                       # ~/.briefcase/budgets.toml, or define them in code:
budgets.budget("daily", usd=20, soft_usd=15)
with budgets.budget_scope(tenant="acme"):
    ...  # calls here count against tenant=acme
